top_signals.title: Ukraine, Saudi Strikes and Soaring Oil Risks
top_signals.summary: Tina Fordham, founder of Fordham Global Foresight joined Bloomberg Open Interest to break down President Trump’s surprise diesel deal with Russia, Zelensky’s demand for an energy ceasefire, and fresh attacks in Ukraine and Saudi Arabia. We unpack what it all means for oil prices, markets, and US, Russia relations. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: CMORG holds sector-wide cloud outage simulation exercise
top_signals.summary: The Cross-Market Operational Resilience Group (CMORG) yesterday (8 October 2026) completed its biennial simulation exercise, known as SIMEX26, focused this year on a global cloud services disruption.

top_signals.title: Saudi Arabia Insists Energy Supply Remains Resilient
top_signals.summary: Despite attacks on Saudi Arabia’s energy and transport infrastructure in recent weeks, the Kingdom’s energy resilience remains strong, Saudi Energy Minister Prince Abdulaziz bin Salman said at the WPC Energy Congress in Riyadh on Monday. “Energy resilience is beyond barrels of spare capacity, of pipelines and gigawatts of generation,” Prince Abdulaziz said, as carried by Bloomberg. “It must also be measured by the ability to maintain, repair, reroute, substitute and recover.
